responsibility: This header declares the common entry points and shared globals used by both lto.cc and lto-dump.cc. It exposes LTO front-end initialization, the routine that reads callgraph and symbols from input files, reporting support, and shared state such as the EH personality declaration, personality bootstrap decl, tree vectors, and machine-mode identity table used during LTO streaming.
same_name_distinction: Declares the small shared interface used by lto.cc and lto-dump.cc—entry points and globals such as lto_fe_init, read_cgraph_and_symbols, and EH/personality state—whereas gcc/lto/lto-common.cc provides the implementations and defines that shared state.
